description: Header file defining the interface for LZ77 decompression support in MikroTik WLAN drivers. It declares the rb_lz77_decompress function, which decompresses data if enabled via configuration.

methods.name: int rb_lz77_decompress(const u8 * in,const size_t in_len,u8 * out,size_t * out_len)
methods.description: Decompresses data using LZ77 algorithm if support is enabled; otherwise returns -EOPNOTSUPP.
